user_instruction: No new entry/MMU/reset probes. Analyze existing source and compiled artifacts. Physical ESP native logical block is 4096; user reports successful mount after 4096-byte FAT reformat.

confirmed_packaging_defect.reason: FAT BPB sector was 512 despite the target logical block size 4096; 8 sectors per cluster did not fix the sector mismatch.

uefi_fat.lines: 74-77 allows 512/1024/2048/4096 BlockIo sizes; 361+ uses BPB sector offsets via DiskIo

interpretation.linux_mount: 512-byte FAT BPB incompatible with 4096-byte device logical blocks
interpretation.uefi: Do not infer universal UEFI failure from Linux rejection; UEFI DiskIo is byte-addressed. New package actually boots a 4096-byte logical/physical QEMU SCSI disk.
interpretation.photo: New menu and existing blue/magenta bands establish that the old menu delivery had already reached XNU; FAT mismatch alone does not identify the later phone stall.
interpretation.cpu_pages: Disk sector size and ARM MMU 4KiB translation granule are independent.
interpretation.storage_layers: B5qUfs physical READ16 uses count*4096 and firstLba+offset/4096; its 512-byte virtual root disk is separately converted into authenticated 4096-byte reads. Do not blindly change virtual image block geometry.
interpretation.display_log: B5_S6E3FC5_AMB338EH01 in photo is the 720x748 panel per original Samsung DT report lines1749-1752, not the 1080x2640 B5_S6E3FAC_AMF670BS03. It does not prove inner scanout shutdown.

source_checks.phone_reported_parange: 2 from supplied photo; no PA-size mismatch established
source_checks.kernel_bootstrap_table_capacity: 16 pages in actual linked entry, two separate TTBR roots; bounds checked
source_checks.source_storage_read_bytes: READ16 count*4096, offset conversion audited without modification

link_and_post.scope: real built outputs; no runtime or desktop assertion

changes: board.toml panic_screen=false prevents the existing payload recipe from adding entry/panic probes
v3 diagnostic builder retired by explicit user instruction
physical ESP builders use FAT32 -S4096 -s1; RAM bootstrap FAT retained with its independent 512-byte BlockIo
installer verifies native4K BPB locally and blockdev --getss before any ESP write
v4 deploys exact raw CI kernel with no additional text patches and only normal menu entries

local_tests.fat: fsck and every member roundtrip PASS
local_tests.installer: actual installer with mocked ADB: wrong sector rejected before writes, 512-byte BPB rejected before ADB, ESP-only check works

efi_max.scope: Real AAVMF/UniXNU/DarwinBoot to raw CI XNU on QEMU max; native 4096-byte disk, no device claim

efi_cortex_a710.scope: Real AAVMF/UniXNU/DarwinBoot to raw CI XNU on QEMU cortex-a710; native 4096-byte disk, no device claim

local_tests.retired_diagnostic_builder: PASS refuses before creating any output

limitations: Offline QEMU is not a Samsung EL2/UH, watchdog, display or UFS handoff emulation. Actual phone stall root cause is not established by this audit.
